source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第七节

textbook_summary: T/U overlap and obscured small T are supported; exact amplitude/timing is authored, not extracted or clinically calibrated.
composition: Existing smooth U stretched/shifted over existing T; fixed source timing; no alteration of P/QRS/ST/T or U coefficients; zero-sum limbs retain identities.
constraints: Only named low-K example; general EcgUWavePlan still rejects negative delay; source QT not a measured fused-wave endpoint.
limitations: No potassium concentration or severity model
No cellular mechanism or automated QT determination
